recognize_zh: 免疫組化中片狀排列的中大型圓形細胞呈瀰漫、強烈的膜/胞質棕色陽性，細胞核圓、以蘇木素淡染；標記雖未標明，但瀰漫性一致陽性的片狀大細胞最像泛 B 細胞標記（如 CD20）染色，符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Sheets of discohesive medium to large round cells
Strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic brown staining in nearly all tumor cells
Round to oval nuclei, hematoxylin counterstained, larger than small lymphocytes
Few interspersed negative cells and small vessels
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antigen not specified) shows sheets of discohesive medium to large round cells with strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in nearly all neoplastic cells, with occasional interspersed negative cells and small vessels. The nuclei are round to oval and larger than those of small lymphocytes. The diffuse, uniform staining of a sheet-like large-cell population is typical of a lineage marker such as CD20 in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, but the specific antigen cannot be confirmed from the image. Findings are supportive of the reported diagnosis of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic neoplasms are CD20- and PAX5-negative but CD138/MUM1-positive, so a CD20-type membranous pattern argues against them.
ALCL shows strong membranous and Golgi CD30 positivity with hallmark cells and is negative for B-cell markers.
Burkitt lymphoma has medium-sized monotonous cells with a starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100%, and MYC rearrangement without BCL2 expression.
